name: gptvis-vue-data-ui-workspace
description: Monorepo for the GPT-Vis VueDataUI adapter and its playground.

scripts.build: npm run build -w gptvis-vue-data-ui && npm run build -w playground
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w gptvis-vue-data-ui && npm run build -w gptvis-vue-data-ui && npm run typecheck -w playground
